what: How FlashGen reaches the int8 weight, on the diner scene at one seed. r13 = kijai's rank-13 resize merged by LoraLoaderModelOnly (h3_probe_t2v_flashgen_4step, the shipped FlashGen probe); r64 = the publisher's full rank 64 merged the same way (h3_probe_t2v_flashgen_r64_4step); r64_branch = rank 64 applied at the call by MiniMaxH3LoRABranch (h3_probe_t2v_flashgen_r64_4step_branch). Same sigmas, sampler, Sol and canvas; 1344x768, 345 frames. r64_branch_dense = r64_branch with Sol off on the kitchen backend, as vllm-omni's NPU recipe runs FlashGen dense.
why: bench/results/2026-09-26_int8_lora_requant.json: merging FlashGen into the int8 convrot weight requantizes it, and its delta is about a hundredth of an int8 step, so the merge keeps it only under rounding noise several times its size. The branch keeps it exactly. The owner, 2026-09-26: make FlashGen work as well as it can before audio refining.
predictions: none registered: a first look. A rendered clip cannot A/B a small numerical change (CLAUDE.md), but this is whether most of the LoRA applies at all.
reruns: 2026-09-26: r64_branch first failed at load (the node's isinstance test refused ComfyUI's mixed-precision Linear; fixed in lora_branch.py) and its row carries that error; r64_branch and r64_branch_dense were rendered after a server restart, so r64_branch's row is the second.
